# Adarsh Singh, CTO at SmokeTrees Digital

> Adarsh Singh leads engineering at SmokeTrees Digital in India. He builds web
> applications, ONDC integrations, and financial reconciliation systems. He
> also maintains open-source tools and shared project templates.
> Contact him by email at me@adarshsingh87.com.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://adarshsingh87.com/): profile, selected work, experience, stack, latest notes
- [Work archive](https://adarshsingh87.com/work): full project list, OSS and tooling first
- [Blog](https://adarshsingh87.com/blog): notes on tooling, ONDC lessons, reconciliation patterns, running a small eng team

## Selected work

- Smoke Context: an Express library that uses async storage to pass request context through a call chain. It lets you trace logs without passing IDs to every function. [GitHub](https://github.com/smoke-trees/smoke-context)
- SmokeTrees Backend Template: shared project layout and setup for TypeScript, Express, and PostgreSQL services. [GitHub](https://github.com/smoke-trees/node-template-ts)
- SmokeTrees Frontend Template: shared routing, data fetching, and styling conventions for Next.js projects using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. [GitHub](https://github.com/smoke-trees/next-FE-template)
- Fomofy / MyFomo: e-commerce product with discovery-focused views and recommendations. [myfomo.in](https://myfomo.in/)
- ONDC integrations: buyer-side and seller-side gift card flows plus a B2B retail seller implementation; production systems serving millions of customers.
- Reconciliation and financial automation: systems that reconcile 3Cr+ in transactions daily. Automation cut repetitive manual work by 50-60% where applied.
- AI chatbots: client support and operations bots with retrieval over client docs and human handoff.
- Shopify connectors: orders, inventory, and storefront-to-system sync.
- Business applications: LMS, CRM, and rewards/recognition builds.

More detail on each: [Work archive](https://adarshsingh87.com/work)

## Stack

- Frontend and mobile: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, React Native, Flutter
- Backend: Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, Express, Hono, Flask, FastAPI, LangChain
- Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, ElasticSearch
- Cloud and deployment: AWS, Azure, Vercel, Cloudflare, Kubernetes
- Daily drivers: Arch Linux, Hyprland, Neovim, OpenCode

## Notes (blog)

- [What building on ONDC taught me about the difference between an API and a protocol](https://adarshsingh87.com/blog/api-vs-protocol-ondc): No central author, callbacks instead of responses, defensive parsing — what changes when you integrate with a shared agreement instead of a service.
- [Async context as a mental model, not just a library](https://adarshsingh87.com/blog/async-context-mental-model): AsyncLocalStorage is really about how a value survives async boundaries — plus the rule for when context helps and when it hides real dependencies.
